question: Which causal source positions in the stable MLP8 singleton naturally generate the shared temporal-Q8 state on a fresh is/was lexicon?

frozen_screen.population: All fresh-v6 A1/A2 rows whose base and donor endpoints were both correct in the completed capability manifest.
frozen_screen.module: MLP8 complete output only; no refitting, other-module union, or attention-head intervention.
frozen_screen.position_partition: For each aligned row: prefix before the unique this/that cue; cue; post-cue/pre-subject token(s); subject determiner at query-1; self at query. These five groups exactly partition positions 0..query.
frozen_screen.target: The released cDAS natural coefficient times its temporal-Q8 projected resid18 axis.

predictions.pred_a_exact_authority_partition_identit: Capability selection, one-cue alignment, exact partition, native/base identities, finite records, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_complete_mlp8_transfers_to_fresh_: Complete MLP8 predicts target behavior with cosine >=0.90 and relative RMSE <=0.50, and target Q8 coordinates with cosine >=0.70 and relative RMSE <=0.90.
predictions.pred_c_at_least_one_proper_position_grou: At least one of cue, post_cue, subject_determiner, or self carries >=25% of complete-MLP8 mean absolute behavior and has Q8 coordinate cosine >=0.50.
predictions.pred_d_causal_prefix_is_zero: MLP8 donor/base output difference before the changed cue is exactly zero to 1e-6 and prefix intervention behavior is <=1e-6.
predictions.pred_e_small_source_union_beats_complete: Either cue_suffix or subject_suffix has target-coordinate relative RMSE no worse than complete MLP8 while using a proper subset of positions.

decision: A passing proper source union becomes the natural shared-Q8 writer boundary for MLP8 Down/product weight splitting. If no proper union improves, split MLP8 output modes directly; do not reopen the full-module greedy sweep.
